## What the original guide said

::: {.callout-note title="Archived explanation · not independently verified reporting"}
Protects the stormwater system from sale or franchise rental, clarifies that conduit space—but not the conduit system itself—may be rented as a franchise, and shifts certain permissions for uses of city property to an executive-agency process established by ordinance.

**Original recommendation: YES.** This records Everett’s pre-election position, not the election result. The archive retains the full reasoning.
:::

[Read the ballot guide](../guide/index.qmd#question-g).
